role: Settings > iCloud & Data > Trash screen: lists intentionally deleted sessions (from RRCollector.checkForDeletedSessions), lets the user restore one or permanently delete one/all, with confirmation dialogs and a transient status banner.
types: TrashView: struct — SwiftUI View for the trash bin
SingleDeleteConfirmation: struct (private ViewModifier) — confirmation dialog gating a single permanent delete
toplevel: #Preview (lines 264-269) renders TrashView in a NavigationStack with a fresh RRCollector() environment. SingleDeleteConfirmation stores @Binding pendingDeleteId and let onDelete closure.

units.does: Builds the Trash List (emptyTrashSection + trashStatusSection) with form background and inline title 'Trash'; on appear loads deleted sessions; attaches the 'Permanently Delete All?' confirmation dialog bound to showingClearAllConfirmation and the SingleDeleteConfirmation modifier bound to pendingDeleteId with permanentlyDelete as onDelete.
units.entry: SwiftUI body; pushed from SettingsPages+Data.swift:424 (NavigationLink); also hosted by EmuquTests/PageSnapshotTests.swift:33 and #Preview. .onAppear triggers loadDeletedSessions.

units.does: Dialog actions for 'Delete All': a destructive 'Delete All' button that calls permanentlyDeleteAll and a no-op Cancel.
units.entry: SwiftUI confirmationDialog actions builder; buttons tapped by user.

units.does: Dialog message text stating all N (deletedSessions.count) deleted sessions will be permanently removed.
units.entry: SwiftUI confirmationDialog message builder.

units.does: Shows the empty-state section when there are no deleted sessions, otherwise the list section followed by the delete-all section.
units.entry: Composed into body.

branches.effect: true: trashIsEmptySection only; false: deletedSessionsSection + clearAllSection

units.does: Section with one deletedSessionRow per deleted session keyed by id, header 'N Deleted Sessions', footer claiming a 90-day retention.
units.entry: Composed into body.

units.does: Section with a destructive full-width button (bodyLabel) that sets showingClearAllConfirmation = true to present the delete-all dialog. The button is disabled while a restore is in flight.
units.entry: Composed into body; button tapped by user.

branches.effect: true: the Delete All button is disabled until the restore finishes

units.does: Shows a caption section with statusMessage in sage text when a status message is set; otherwise nothing.
units.entry: Composed into body.

branches.effect: true: renders the message section; false: renders nothing

units.does: Empty-state section: trash.slash icon, 'Trash is Empty' headline and explanatory caption.
units.entry: Composed into body via emptyTrashSection.

units.does: Label for the delete-all button: trash.fill icon with 'Permanently Delete All', full width.
units.entry: Composed into clearAllSection.

units.does: Row for one deleted session: formatted date, beat count caption, and either a spinner (while that row is being restored) or the restore/delete buttons, which are disabled while any restore is in flight.
units.entry: Called from ForEach in deletedSessionsSection.

branches.cond: isRestoring and restoringId equals this session's id
branches.effect: true: shows ProgressView in place of buttons; false: shows trashRowActions, disabled while isRestoring so no second restore or delete starts during one

units.does: Two 44pt icon buttons: Restore (calls restoreSession(id)) and Permanently delete (sets pendingDeleteId = id to show the confirmation dialog).
units.entry: Button closures run on user tap.

units.does: Builds a plain-style 44x44 SF Symbol button with tint, accessibility label and hint, running the given action closure.
units.entry: Button action invoked by SwiftUI on tap.
calls: closure:action supplied by trashRowActions (restoreSession or set pendingDeleteId)

units.does: Replaces deletedSessions with RRCollector.checkForDeletedSessions(): raw backups whose id is in the archive's deletedIds, plus trashed session files in deletedIds that have no raw backup. Runs synchronously on the main actor.
units.entry: Called from .onAppear and after restore/delete actions.
reads: file:raw RR backups (index + every backup decoded via RawRRBackup.allBackups)
file:Archive/Trash/<id>.session (directory listing + decode of each trashed file)

units.does: Marks the row as restoring, then in a Task awaits RRCollector.restoreFromTrash(id) (unmark deleted, restore kept trash file or rebuild from raw backup) and hands success (non-nil session) to finishRestore on the main actor.
units.entry: Restore button tap via trashRowActions.

units.does: Clears restoring state and reloads the list either way; on success shows 'Session restored successfully' as a transient banner (showTransientStatus); on failure shows 'Failed to restore session', which persists.
units.entry: Called on MainActor from restoreSession's Task.

branches.effect: true: transient success banner; false: failure message kept (the list is reloaded in both cases)

units.does: Sets statusMessage to the message, then after 3 s (sleepQuietly) calls clearStatus(ifStill:) on the main actor, which clears it only if it still holds that same message, so a failure message set meanwhile stays.
units.entry: Called from finishRestore (success) and permanentlyDeleteAll.

units.does: Clears statusMessage only if it still equals the given message; a newer message is left alone.
units.entry: Called from showTransientStatus's delayed Task on the main actor.

branches.effect: true: cleared; false (replaced meanwhile): left alone

units.does: Permanently deletes one session via RRCollector.permanentlyDelete (remove trash file, discard raw backup, delete iCloud live backup, forget deleted id) then reloads the list.
units.entry: Passed as onDelete to SingleDeleteConfirmation; runs on confirm.

units.does: Permanently deletes every listed session through RRCollector.permanentlyDelete, reloads, and shows 'All deleted sessions permanently removed' as a transient banner (showTransientStatus).
units.entry: Delete All confirmation button.

branches.effect: calls permanentlyDelete per id; empty list does nothing; per-id failures are only debug-logged inside the service so the success banner shows regardless

units.does: Formats a date with a new DateFormatter in the app locale, medium date + short time.
ViewModifier body: attaches a 'Permanently Delete Session?' confirmation dialog shown while pendingDeleteId is non-nil; dismissing sets pendingDeleteId nil.
units.entry: SwiftUI ViewModifier.body, applied by TrashView.body via .modifier.

branches.effect: true: pendingDeleteId = nil; when true is set nothing happens

units.does: Dialog buttons: destructive Delete calls onDelete(pendingDeleteId) when set then clears it; Cancel clears pendingDeleteId.
units.entry: Confirmation dialog buttons tapped by user.

branches.effect: true: onDelete(id); false: no delete; either way pendingDeleteId set nil
